verdict.rationale: dlt supports loading into LanceDB, a vector store destination, and has broad LLM-adjacent tooling (dltHub AI Harness, MCP server, llms.txt) that suggests AI-native retrieval workflows, plus general-purpose querying via pipeline.dataset(). However, evidence for 'LLM-ready formats' beyond LanceDB (e.g., other vector DBs like Pinecone/Weaviate/Chroma, embeddings generation) is absent, and there's no direct evidence of an agent retrieving synced data end-to-end beyond dataset querying. missing for 10: broader vector-store destination coverage, embedding/LLM-ready format generation, and concrete agent-retrieval workflow evidence.
